pkgmetadata.longdescription:
TrailBase is a single-executable, sub-millisecond open-source Firebase alternative with type-safe REST and realtime APIs, auth, an admin UI, and a WebAssembly runtime. It is built on Rust, SQLite, and Wasmtime. The binary installed is named 'trail'.
Note: built from upstream's pre-compiled musl static release binary. Source build requires 900+ npm packages for the embedded admin UI and cannot be reproduced in a standard Gentoo network sandbox.
